subject.title: fix(ui): sidebar Settings entry scrolls away instead of staying pinned in the footer

question: Should this narrow Settings-footer fix land independently, or should maintainers fold it into the broader pinned-nav redesign in `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100296`?
rationale: The patch itself looks correct, but the protected maintainer label and overlapping broader redesign make landing order a maintainer sequencing choice rather than a cleanup-close decision.

options.title: Land the narrow fix
options.body: Merge this small PR now to keep Settings pinned without taking the larger persisted-navigation redesign.

options.title: Fold into the redesign
options.body: Close or defer this PR only if maintainers decide the broader pinned-nav PR should own the Settings-footer behavior too.

options.title: Pause both paths
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a different sidebar information architecture before changing Settings placement.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow fix
recommendation.body: Merge this small PR now to keep Settings pinned without taking the larger persisted-navigation redesign.

likelyOwner.reason: The same person owns the current sidebar history and both the narrow PR and the broader sidebar redesign context.
